## Highlights

- Run a selected native route with `wclass run --review`: the same process displays the
  task-free route on the controlling terminal, asks for confirmation, and starts at most one
  child without requiring a copied fingerprint.
- Use `wclass-advisory ask` for a stateless read-only review, research, diagnosis, or design
  answer with the selected CLI's configured default model. It needs no initialization, profile,
  campaign, project verifier, route digest, or task file.
- Use grouped `campaign`, `skill`, and `advanced` command families. Existing flat commands remain
  accepted for automation compatibility.
- Send new campaign tasks on standard input. The managed parent forwards bounded task bytes to
  package-pinned runners through anonymous pipes without creating a task pathname.
- Scaffold a safe reject-all project verifier with `campaign verifier scaffold`, check committed
  customization and baseline rejection with `campaign verifier check`, and inspect or remove only
  exact package-owned Agent Skill bundles with `skill status` and `skill uninstall --confirm`.
- Install Agent Skill onboarding generation 15, which uses one-shot `ask` for ordinary advisory
  modes and reserves campaign setup for implementation or explicit measurement.

## Compatibility and safety

- Piped output remains JSON. On a terminal, non-execution `wclass` commands and
  `wclass-advisory ask` render human-readable output by default; pass `--json` for machine output
  or `--human` explicitly. A bare `wclass` or `wclass-advisory` invocation now prints help and
  exits successfully.
- Existing `route` plus `--ack-route-fingerprint`, flat advisory commands, managed task-file
  dispatch, explicit-profile consult, and low-level campaign commands remain available.
- Guided review supports schema-1, native schema-2, and observation-bound native schema-3 routes.
  Route identifiers now reject terminal control characters, and built-in executable resolution is
  checked again after the human confirmation pause.

## Security boundaries

Stateless ask performs two task-free bounded local `--help`/`--version` probes before reading the
task, then starts one task-bearing child after explicit egress consent. Route permissions request
read-only behavior and a bounded no-follow snapshot rejects non-`.git` worktree mutations. The
receipt explicitly reports `git_metadata_checked:false`, `quality_verified:false`, and
`host_filesystem_confined:false`; use an external container or jail for a hostile CLI or
repository. Agy retains its documented argv process-inspection exposure, while Grok uses an
inherited anonymous `/dev/fd/N` pipe.

Exact-bundle uninstall renames the selected Skill to a private tombstone, revalidates the bound
directory descriptor, and deletes only the verified package files. Customized, extra-file, or
symlinked destinations fail closed.

Three scrubbed GLM reviews covered the runtime and Skill/documentation surfaces. Confirmed
lazy-loader, escalation fingerprint, terminal-control, child-cleanup, claim-consistency, and
destructive-race issues were fixed and retested. The final complete Codex Security working-tree
diff scan reviewed all 13 changed production files with complete coverage and retained no finding;
TAC status was unavailable because the connector was not connected.

Full validation passed 1,540 tests with 35 skips; extracted-sdist isolation passed 1,528 tests
with 79 skips. Ruff check and format-check passed 201 files, strict mypy passed 198 source files,
the distribution build and isolation checks passed, and both implementation PRs passed the full
Python 3.10-3.14 and macOS Python 3.10/3.14 CI matrix.

## Installation

```sh
uv tool install --upgrade "weightclass==0.27.0"
brew upgrade ictechgy/tap/weightclass
```
